name: dogfood-storybook-8-mdx-app
description: Dogfood app (v1.34-4) — a Storybook 8 harness that binds 12 components + 3 layout + 5 interaction stories to MDX docs (component preview + prose + code sample), exercises the @storybook/test interaction runner, and emits a story coverage report. Both mock (@kiwa-lab/component createStoryRegistry + MdxRegistry + InteractionRunner + CoverageReporter) and real (STORYBOOK_URL preview + STORYBOOK_MDX_READY=1 gate) satisfy the same 8-op contract so the fidelity harness can diff them side-by-side.

scripts.test: node ../../scripts/build-deps.mjs @kiwa-lab/component @kiwa-lab/core @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
